title: Matching-LLM: Historically Anchored Synthetic Prediction of Public Opinion and Elections
abstract: arXiv:2411.01582v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for predicting public opinion and electoral behavior, but their synthetic responses may not fully reflect human attitudes and heterogeneity. This study introduces Matching-LLM, a weighted framework that combines LLM-generated responses with historical human behavioral data. Using the World Values Survey, American National Election Studies, and German election survey data, we evaluate its performance in reconstructing survey responses and predicting election outcomes. Results show that Matching-LLM generally improves accuracy relative to LLM-only, including 11 of 12 comparisons on survey questions excluded from calibration, although it does not consistently outperform History-only. In the 2024 U.S. presidential election, Matching-LLM predicts 310 Republican electoral votes, compared with the actual 312, outperforming both single-source benchmarks in electoral-vote accuracy. translated_title: Matching-LLM：基于历史锚定的公众舆论与选举合成预测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为预测公众舆论和选举行为提供了新的机会，但其合成响应可能无法完全反映人类态度及其异质性。本研究提出了Matching-LLM，这是一个将LLM生成的响应与历史人类行为数据相结合的加权框架。利用世界价值观调查、美国全国选举研究以及德国选举调查数据，我们评估了该方法在重构调查响应和预测选举结果方面的表现。结果表明，相较于仅使用LLM的方法，Matching-LLM通常能提高准确性，包括在12项未纳入校准的调查问题比较中有11项表现更优，尽管它并不能持续超越仅使用历史数据的方法。在2024年美国总统选举中，Matching-LLM预测共和党获得310张选举人票，与实际的312张相比，在选举人票准确性上优于两个单源基准方法。
tldr: Matching-LLM框架通过将大语言模型生成的响应与历史人类行为数据加权融合，在调查响应重构和2024年美国总统选举预测中表现出色，预测共和党获得310张选举人票（实际为312张），准确性优于仅依赖单一数据源的方法。
en_tdlr: Matching-LLM is a weighted framework that combines LLM-generated responses with historical human behavioral data, improving accuracy in reconstructing survey responses and predicting the 2024 U.S. presidential election (310 Republican electoral votes versus the actual 312), outperforming both single-source benchmarks.
